name: Created Date Views Filters
description: Adds two Views filters on the entity created date: a Year dropdown and a Month dropdown.
notes: Registers two Views filter handlers via hook_views_data() on the pseudo-table 'views' with field 'created': year_filter (Drupal\created_date_views_filters\Plugin\views\filter\YearFilter, id 'year_filter', title 'Year filter - Filter') and month_filter (MonthFilter, id 'month_filter', title 'Month filter - Filter'). Both extend FilterPluginBase (not the date/numeric base, so no operator/min-max UI). YearFilter renders a select of the last six years (date('Y')-5 through current year, default current year); its query() adds addWhereExpression(0, "EXTRACT(YEAR FROM FROM_UNIXTIME($table.created)) = :year", [':year' => value]). MonthFilter renders a select of month names january..december, converts the chosen name to a month number with date('m', strtotime($value)), then addWhereExpression(0, "EXTRACT(MONTH FROM FROM_UNIXTIME($table.created)) = :month"). $table is array_key_first($query->tables) (the View's first/base table) -- NOT the field's own table, so on Views whose base table is not the one holding 'created' (or with an aliased first table) the generated SQL can reference a wrong/absent column. EXTRACT ... FROM_UNIXTIME is MySQL/MariaDB syntax; it is not portable to PostgreSQL or SQLite. No config, no schema, no permissions, no services, no admin form -- everything is done per-View in the Views UI. README lists maintainer chanderbhushan.
project_description:
This module provides the months and years dropdown filter for a created date in views.

Requirements: this module requires core module Views.

Installation: install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module.

Configuration: the module has no menu or modifiable settings. There is no configuration. When enabled, the module provides the "Month filter: Filter" and "Year filter: Filter" in the view.
